narrative: Markets await guidance from Donald Trump as central bank speakers highlight lingering inflation threats — ECB's Lagarde and BoE's Bailey both warn of secondary energy price shocks. risk-premium flows and oil surges trim risk asset bids, sending gold higher +1.27% near $4,125; equities -3.58%; DXY -0.02%; VIX 24.5. USD/JPY holds at 157.84 supported by the 274bp Fed-BoJ carry advantage. Attention shifts to US Nonfarm Payrolls at 13:30 UTC.
